IF
Opened(S_UND_HarperSpy_HarperStash_e776f2aa-0a7f-40b7-a4ec-7f951c7a5724)
AND
DB_Players(_Player)
AND
QuestUpdateIsUnlocked(_Player, "HIDDEN_WLD_Boosters", "UND_HarperSpy_OpenedStash", 0)
AND
QuestUpdateIsUnlocked(_Player, "HIDDEN_WLD_Boosters", "UND_HarperSpy_OpenedStashAvoidedMimics", 0)
THEN
QuestUpdate(_Player, "HIDDEN_WLD_Boosters", "UND_HarperSpy_OpenedStash");

PROC
PROC_BlockLockpickItem(_Player, S_WYR_Circus_EntranceGate_243c4eaa-d26b-4eda-8c04-b1f00c4d7492)
AND
NOT DB_GlobalFlag((FLAG)WYR_Circus_State_CheckpointGainedAccess_6c332552-395f-6f80-a0e7-d2450ab0812d)
AND
CanSee((CHARACTER)S_WYR_Circus_EntranceGuard_63ef213e-7a72-4126-9d5f-2f7d60ee9178, _Player, 1)
AND
QRY_WYR_Circus_TryStartEntranceCheckpointDialog(_Player)
THEN
